project.description:
ARIA Pay provides a single merchant integration (Credit Card | ARIA Pay at checkout) that routes through ARIA Connect to whichever exchange/wallet the customer already uses, settling via ARIA Chain/Ledger — removing the need for merchants to integrate exchange-by-exchange and for customers to learn crypto mechanics.
A decentralized Proof-of-Stake network built on Substrate. Public, inspectable, and built to evolve without forks.
